name: todo-api
description: The backend service owning task data for the todo webapp: create, edit, complete, reopen, delete, tag, and query tasks (filter/sort by tag, due date, priority) scoped to the signed-in caller only. Sits behind the API gateway, which injects the validated caller identity; the service does not issue or validate tokens itself and does not serve any UI.

dependencies.name: todo-db
dependencies.description: Stores each user's tasks (title, tags, due date, priority, completion state).

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Validates the caller's Thunder-issued token (via the gateway) and resolves the signed-in user's identity to scope tasks to that user.
